articles.title: Stella Wallace, 66, Bus Driver
articles.deck: Friends remember Stella Wallace for the many years of service to Kettle Hill.
body: Born in Kettle Hill in the years after the war, Stella Wallace spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Stella Wallace died in October at home on Elm Drive, at the age of 66.
